contexts.text: There, they abuse their faculty of understanding truths to gain dominion...
When they abuse heavenly order to do evil...
Magic is especially the abuse of correspondences. AC 7026.
The abuse of Divine order. Signified.
The abuse of order and of correspondences. Explained. AC 7298, Explained. AC 7332:end. AC 7337, Example(s). AC 8870:2.
The things that flow from order are not changed by abuse...
Their power of abusing order is there taken away...
The abuse of Divine good. Signified.
It is called an abuse when what is similar exists in ultimates, but from a contrary origin...
One of the wicked arts of Infernal Spirits has relation to the abuse of correspondences; a second, to the abuse of the ultimates of Divine order.
There are Spirits who abuse this communication of the Word with the Heavens. Described. TCR 235.
Occurs. DLW 255. DP 96:5. DP 233:11.
The origin of evil is from the abuse of the faculties of rationality and freedom. General article.
An evil man abuses these faculties to confirm evils and falsities. General article.
There is also the abuse of uses, but abuse does not take away use... except with those who make it.
Since man has abused the faculty of elevating his understanding...
It is from the abuse of these faculties that man can appear different in outward things from what he is in inward.
Men have abused freedom to will and do evil, and rationality to think and confirm it.
It follows that man could abuse these faculties...
The truths you have abused to confirm...
Man dooms himself to Hell by the abuse of freewill in spiritual things...
